title: SCS Bundle
description: Schema for SCS Bundle manifests. Bundles are container documents that organize and reference SCDs. They are NOT SCDs themselves - they are manifests similar to Docker container manifests or Kubernetes pod specs.

id.description: Unique bundle identifier using bundle: prefix (e.g., bundle:medication-adherence, bundle:architecture)

type.description: Bundle type: 'domain' (an organization's governance, also called Global), 'project' (one project's governance), 'meta' (vocabulary, published with the spec), 'concept' (a Domain Ontology concept, RFC-0001), 'standards' (deprecated in 0.6.0; use citation references)

version.description: Semantic version (e.g., 1.0.0) or DRAFT for working bundles

description.description: Summary of what this bundle represents

imports.description: List of external bundle references with versions (e.g., bundle:architecture:1.0.0). Domain bundles import a meta bundle and concept bundles. Project bundles MAY import concept bundles and MUST NOT import meta, domain, or project bundles. Concept bundles MUST have empty imports array.

items.description: Bundle reference with optional version (e.g., bundle:meta:1.0.0 or bundle:meta)

scds.description: List of SCD identifiers included directly in this bundle (not from imports). A bundle lists SCDs or imports, not both (bundle-format.md §9.3).

created_by.description: Email or identifier of bundle creator

updated_by.description: Email or identifier of last updater

version_approved_by.description: Email or identifier of the person who approved this bundle version (RFC-0001: single-source MVP, not per-concept).

rationale.description: Explanation of why this bundle version was created or updated

provenance.description: Provenance tracking for bundle changes. created_by/created_at/updated_by/updated_at record authorship; version_approved_by/version_approved_at record that someone with standing reviewed and agreed to this version (RFC-0001).

imports.description: Concept bundles MUST NOT import other bundles - they contain only SCDs

scds.description: Concept bundles MUST contain at least one SCD

imports.description: Domain bundles MUST import at least one concept bundle (and MAY import one meta bundle)

scds.description: Domain bundles hold their rules in concept bundles, not as direct SCDs
Meta bundles MUST contain at least one meta-tier SCD
Standards bundles may contain standards-tier SCDs or import other standards bundles

provenance.description: A real (non-DRAFT) version requires approval (RFC-0001, Provenance and approval). DRAFT working bundles don't - approval only applies once you're cutting an actual version.

$comment: Bundle Types (0.6.0): domain (organization governance, also called Global; imports meta + concept bundles), project (one project's governance; independent of domain), meta (foundational vocabulary, published with the spec), concept (a Domain Ontology concept, RFC-0001), standards (deprecated; use citation references)
